description: Localized dates and times that .NET and ESM write differently for a CLDR locale both runtimes' ICU has data for, compared with ICU 78 (CLDR 48) on Linux by LocalizedFormatComparisonTests. Every other difference in that comparison is within the corpus tolerance (U+0020/U+00A0/U+202F, U+0027/U+2019). Locales the JavaScript engine has no data for are not compared: Intl falls back to another locale there.

divergences.reason: CLDR writes the month of haw's short date in lowercase Roman numerals (d/M/yy with M=romanlow); .NET has no Roman numbering and writes Arabic digits. Node writes the numerals; Bun 1.4 writes Arabic digits, as .NET does.
